items.name: jyotish-chakra
items.title: Jyotish Chakra
items.caption: The Graha-Nakshatra Mandala: rāśis, nakshatras, padas and every graha, with the D1 chart in the centre. Hover details sit beside the wheel.

items.name: charts
items.title: South and North Indian charts
items.caption: Ārūḍha padas at the top of each rāśi, aspect marks at the bottom; crowded North Indian houses fit their shape.

items.name: vargas
items.title: Divisional charts
items.caption: D1 to D60 side by side.

items.name: aspects
items.title: Aspects
items.caption: Graha drishti, rāśi drishti and sputa drishti in virūpas, on grahas, houses and cusps.

items.name: bhavas
items.title: Bhāvas
items.caption: Every house, where its lord sits, and lordships in D1, D9 and D10 with the exchanges between lords.

items.name: maitri
items.title: Maitri and dignities
items.caption: Compound relationships of the nine grahas, the nakshatra tārā matrix and dignities in 16 divisions.

items.name: strength
items.title: Strength
items.caption: Ṣaḍbala with the cut-off at the required minimum, bhāva bala and viṃśopaka.

items.name: ashtakavarga
items.title: Aṣṭakavarga
items.caption: Bhinna and sarva aṣṭakavarga.

items.name: dasha
items.title: Daśā

items.name: yoga-parivartana
items.title: Yogas
items.caption: Each yoga present, with how it forms, strength checks, timing and its reading. Shown: the Jupiter–Saturn parivartana.

items.name: sahams
items.title: Sahams

items.name: sarvatobhadra

items.caption: The 9×9 chakra framed by nakshatra, pada-sound and pada bands, with vedha lines and borders.

items.name: kota
items.title: Kota chakra
items.caption: The fort: Bāhya, Prākāra, Madhya and Stambha, with the paths in and out.

items.name: varshaphala
items.title: Varṣaphala
items.caption: The annual chart, muntha, office-bearers and the five-fold strengths.

items.name: pancha-pakshi
items.title: Pañca pakṣī
items.caption: The five birds through the day and the night, the current yāma, and the sub-periods.

items.name: kp
items.title: KP
items.caption: Sub-lords, cusps and significator tables by bhāva and by graha.

items.name: panchanga
items.title: Pañcāṅga

items.name: human-design

items.caption: The standard BodyGraph with gates, channels and properties.

items.name: numerology
items.title: Numerology

items.caption: Number 100 fixes the Ascendant; Placidus cusps, sub-lords and significators at the moment of judgement.

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare workspace
items.caption: Natal, progressed and transit positions side by side, recomputed offline by the embedded engine.
